ownership.quote: Notte: Browser infra for AI agents: sessions, auth, proxies, payments | Y Combinator

stage.note: Only a Y Combinator backing is confirmed (S25 batch, standard YC deal); no post-YC priced round (amount/date/lead) could be found in public sources within the research window. Stage is inferred as seed because YC's own investment is the only confirmed funding event and YC typically funds at pre-seed/seed; treat as approximate.

note: YC company page (S25, status Active) lists website https://www.notte.cc/ matching the card's domain (notte.cc) exactly — the hint is confirmed, not a different company. Founders: Andrea Pinto (CEO) and Lucas Giordano (CTO), San Francisco, founded 2025. Product is open-source-core (GitHub nottelabs/notte, SSPL-1.0 license) plus a paid hosted API/console. Extensive search (DuckDuckGo, Bing, Google, Marginalia, Tracxn, Crunchbase, TechCrunch, HN Algolia) was blocked by bot-protection or returned no company-specific funding articles, so no priced round beyond the YC investment itself could be confirmed as of 2026-09-30.
